    """
    Initialize BPE tokenizer.

        raise ValueError("vocab_size must be a positive integer")
    self.target_vocab_size = vocab_size
    self.vocab = []
    self.merges = []  # List of (pair, new_token) merges
    self.token_to_id = {}
    self.id_to_token = {}
